acceptance: A member with no dependencies whose base is a recorded integration head prepares; a base that is neither the start head nor a recorded integration head is refused.
A synced member's receipt lists only its own changed files; a path outside its frozen scope is still refused.
An overlap with an earlier member is recorded on prepare; final evidence lacking current-acceptance evidence for each overlapped earlier member is refused.
The silent-revert counterexample (member B descends from A, restores A's line and lands last) cannot reach passing final evidence without A's acceptance rerun recorded.
Receipts carry the new schema version; old-schema receipts are refused under the new semantics.
Merged on joeharris76/todo-db main with a test for each case.
context: Decision gate: start only after todo-db-batch-v2-contract-20261101 is done. Guardrails: work in joeharris76/todo-db under its own repository rules, on a branch and PR, never directly on main; never patch the vendored wheel in BenchBox; one server stays one worker identity (todo-db ADRs 0003 and 0006); every new refusal fails closed with a gate code and recovery steps; BenchBox line citations refer to the vendored 0.12.0 wheel (_project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.12.0-py3-none-any.whl), so re-read todo-db main before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring.
description: Implement the dispatch-base and overlap parts of the batch v2 ADR. prepare accepts a source base equal to the batch start head or any integration head this batch recorded (by prepare or advance) and refuses any other base. Changed files are measured from that base, so a member that merged in the current integration head lists only its own files; per-member frozen scope stays enforced. When a later member changes files an earlier member changed, prepare records the overlap (members and paths) instead of refusing, and final evidence then requires current-acceptance evidence for each overlapped earlier member at the final head. Receipts keep the integration head they were integrated at and move to a new versioned schema.
